title: dvacore trace threshold semantics
question: Does the installed AE 25.6 dvacore trace manager enforce runtime master/category thresholds through TraceEnabled, and is the behavior reproducible?
source_note: Runs in a disposable standalone process against the installed dvacore.dll and reads the existing 25.6 Trace Database without modifying the profile file.

environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER; Parsec Virtual Display Adapter
environment.notes: MSVC 14.44.35207; raw environment captured in runs/EXP-OBS-002/environment.txt

hypotheses.prediction: Lowering master trace volume below a message level makes TraceEnabled false even when the category volume allows it.
hypotheses.falsified_by: TraceEnabled remains true for level 4 with master volume 3 and category volume 5.

hypotheses.prediction: The effective trace threshold is bounded by both master and category volume.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Level 6 becomes enabled with master 10 while category volume remains 5, or level 4 remains enabled with master 3.

procedure: Load installed dvacore.dll in a standalone disposable process.
Load the existing AE 25.6 Trace Database text into the runtime trace manager.
Install MasterTraceToStdErr and query category volume through GetTraceVolume.
Set master volume to 3 and conditionally emit levels 2 and 4 only when TraceEnabled returns true.
Set master volume to 10 and conditionally emit levels 4 and 6.
Repeat in a second fresh process and preserve stdout/stderr plus SHA-256 hashes.

result.conclusion: Replicated: with category volume 5, master=3 produced enabled246=100 and emitted only level 2; master=10 produced enabled246=110 and added level 4 while level 6 remained disabled. Runtime trace filtering is therefore bounded by both master and category thresholds through TraceEnabled.
result.notes: The low-level Trace emitter itself does not filter; callers are expected to consult TraceEnabled. Category-level SetTraceVolume changed TraceChangeCount but did not change GetTraceVolume in this standalone context, so dynamic per-category mutation remains an open question.
